author: Codex

findings.text: The exact API error was “Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled.” The route advertised support for the reasoning parameter, which did not mean it accepted reasoning.enabled=false. Preserve this configuration failure. A future reasoning-enabled protocol must retain traces separately and feed only visible replies into self-play.
findings.title: Liquid requires a separate reasoning-enabled condition

findings.text: The response identified limit_source=upstream_provider_shared_pool. This is not evidence that the account exhausted its daily allowance or that Gemma cannot follow the prompt. The conservative frozen rule stopped the entire batch on any 429; it did not dispatch requests to Nemotron, Inkling or Ling.
findings.title: Gemma’s failure came from the shared provider pool

findings.text: There are zero visible participant replies and no started self-play roots in this screen. Nonduality, experience questions, topic drift and instruction compliance remain unmeasured. The five active routes were a catalog observation, not proof of usable inference.
findings.title: No conclusion about conversational attraction yet

findings.text: Predeclare independent provider lanes for the three untested configurations: Nemotron Lightning, Inkling Small and Ling Flash VL. Stop only the affected lane on an explicitly identified upstream shared-pool limit, while account limits and unknown accounting still stop the whole batch. Keep Liquid reasoning-enabled as a separate condition and revisit Gemma after availability changes. Do not overwrite or resume this closed batch.
findings.title: A concrete next screen

method: Technical reading of both complete API error responses and the frozen catalog/route metadata. No participant text exists; no human ratings or semantic classification.
summary: The first free-model screen tested service compatibility, but produced no behavioral sample. Liquid rejected reasoning-disabled requests; Gemma returned a shared-provider rate limit. The frozen stop rule closed the batch after two calls. Three other eligible models remain untested; Nex had no eligible route at the freeze.
